conclusions: Neither inherited search counts nor the extra proximity margin are physical feasibility proofs; all failures remain bounded-search outcomes.
More search states alone did not resolve this candidate. Do not repeat these configurations without changed evidence or solver logic.

The single-sheet contract-group-face interface restricts combined changes: experiment_observers.hpp stores one optional string, CLI rejects repeated flags, zone generation selects one sheet and orientation recovery expands that one sheet.
Next investigate joint changes across eligible groups with explicit hardware qualification and preserved incumbents/accounting, rather than continuing scalar search-count increases.
